notes_for_editor: Main open question: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 2010 as the year it was abandoned, yet the same page is tagged Actively Staffed, and the Keeping Watch interview and firelookout.com describe current summer or funded staffing. No dated source resolves it; the story reports both. The Keeping Watch item metadata gives Date Created 2021-09-25. The Forest Service Selway-Bitterroot lookout table (fs.usda.gov/media/259187) lists Spot Mtn. at 9 miles northwest of Magruder R.S. with a two-story log cabin (1922) and a 10 ft pole L-4 (1934), but its status column is ambiguous, so it was not cited. The Lynx Fire call-in is described on Keeping Watch but is not recorded as an event. The 2017 Eagle Creek evacuation is tied to the tower by the interview and a photo caption, so it is recorded as a 2017 fire event (corrected in fact-check 2026-10-08). Record height_m 3.0 matches the 10-foot concrete base, not the total tower height; no source gives total height, so height_m is omitted. Record elevation 2445.7 m matches the NHLR 2,446 m figure. Reader comments on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page were not used as sources. Trail length is not given anywhere in the sources.
